documents.title: Orthopedic clinic visit
documents.author: H. Malik (Orthopedics)
documents.text:
Chief complaint: right knee pain for 7 months.
History: Unable to walk more than 10 minutes without stopping. No prior imaging of the knee is on file.
Assessment: Chronic right knee pain, suspected osteoarthritis.
Plan: Request MRI of the right knee without contrast.

documents.title: Physiotherapy discharge summary
documents.author: Physiotherapy department
documents.text:
Completed 8 weeks of physiotherapy (01 Jul to 26 Aug 2026) with partial relief.
Pain persists on prolonged standing.
